source: Owner direct chat after controller reported the map hash change
decision: Preserve the owner-edited current map. Do not restore or overwrite it with the reviewed worker map.
review_scope: MSQ-21 PASS applies to the worker version before the owner edit, not to the subsequently edited map bytes.
acceptance_scope: Confirmation of edit authorship does not establish final 3D or atmosphere acceptance.
observation_scope: The observed hash is a snapshot, not a freeze; the owner may continue editing.
